name: bug1_invalid_sensor_rejected
description: Disabling a non-existent sensor ID must return ERR INVALID_SENSOR and leave sensor 0 armed.

name: bug2_guard_patrol_4_zone_loop

description: Within the same timestamp, alert_level must never be downgraded by a lower severity event.
